text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Verxina announced her entry in the 
Victoria Mile to face Vivlos in a 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If running the Tiara route pushed Vivlos's 
dream further away... then the Trainer 
promises to give her a race just as 
fulfilling as the one in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos shows pure delight at the thought 
of a serious showdown with her sister, 
something she had never even dreamed of. 
And the words her Trainer gave her were—
choice_data_list:
Let's stand in their way with all our 
might!
Let's enjoy this to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Resolved to give it her all, Vivlos boldly 
declared war against her older sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If you beat Verxina, you'll be a super 
celeb." With those words from her Trainer, 
Vivlos was brimming with energy once 
again.
